name: Dolphin PR #14830: SDLGamepad: Add Misc 2 through 6 + Custom Storage Location
body: Built from custom master branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch. Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14830`. ### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14830](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14830) **Title:** SDLGamepad: Add Misc 2 through 6 **Author:** [@JoshuaVandaele](https://github.com/JoshuaVandaele) #### PR Description Misc 2-6 are currently unnamed generic buttons in Dolphin. SDL3 has added more misc buttons for "additional controller buttons" (e.g. left/right trigger clicks on a GameCube controller, or for the second touchpad click on the Steam Controller) which map to these additional named Misc buttons. The names Misc 2-6 are taken from [SDL_GamepadButton](https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL3/SDL_GamepadButton). This change is backwards compatible with old configs, as seen in this screenshot where I only press Misc 2: This is an unofficial community build, not affiliated with the Dolphin team.

name: Dolphin PR #14837: VideoCommon: separate out reinterpret and palette texture creation from rendering + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom master branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14837`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14837](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14837)
**Title:** VideoCommon: separate out reinterpret and palette texture creation from rendering
**Author:** [@iwubcode](https://github.com/iwubcode)

#### PR Description
Late last year I started working on a new feature that required Dolphin to think about how it renders in a different way. In order to prepare for that, I will be creating some PRs that restructure or refactor our existing code.

This PR is for the texture cache. All it does is separate out the rendering of palette and reinterpret paths from the actual texture entry creation.  This one isn't very exciting but I swear there's more excitement coming!

Functionality should not change with these PRs. I did some mild testing but fifo ci should hopefully confirm if any changes slipped through.

This is an unofficial community build, not affiliated with the Dolphin team.

# Packages

## Targets

Each build is optimized for a specific architecture and uses a specific compiler.

- **arm64-v8a**: For devices that use the armv8-a instruction set; e.g. Snapdragon X, all Android devices, and Apple Silicon Macs.
- **x86_64**: For devices that use the x86_64 instruction set; this is exclusively used by Intel and AMD CPUs and is only found on desktops.
- **v3**: For devices that use the x86_64-v3 instruction set or newer; this is found on Ryzen, Intel 4th Generation (Haswell), and newer.

### PGO

PGO builds usually perform ~10-30% better than standard builds, and are thus generally recommended for all users.

## Linux

Linux packages are distributed via AppImage.
[zsync](https://zsync.moria.org.uk/) files are provided for easier updating, such as via
[AM](https://github.com/ivan-hc/AM).

name: Pull request #4344: vulkan: force subgroup-in-geometry fallback on Turnip
body:
Pull request build #[4344](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/pulls/4344)

Commit: [`b8465770370049eb222769254d773174e1323125`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/b8465770370049eb222769254d773174e1323125)

Merge base: [`e5b656e372`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/e5b656e372)
([Master Build](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-ci/master/releases?q=e5b656e372&expanded=true))

## Changelog
Turnip reports VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT in
supportedStages, but its ballot/shuffle results in the
geometry stage are wrong, corrupting the compaction-based
draws (missing/incorrect meshes and textures observed in
NieR Automata). Vendor Qualcomm drivers don't advertise
geometry support and use the existing fallback correctly.
Force the fallback on Turnip too, ignoring the advertised
capability.
